base_bf16_vs_host.summary: At bf16 the release reproduces the base model's greedy continuation on 18 of 20 prompts; the differences are paraphrase-level and begin a median of 121 characters into a 48-token continuation. Quantization widens that gap in the way quantization does, and the comparison for each quantized format is against the same format of the base model, not against bf16.

method.decoding: greedy, argmax over the text vocabulary
method.comparison: decoded text, exact string equality, with the first differing character
method.note: the release and the base model tokenize all 20 prompts to identical ids, so the comparison is of continuations rather than of tokenizers
